column1: #Text=chore: update mermaid packages to latest & isolate them in Renovate
#Text=- Bump all mermaid packages to their latest versions:
#Text=- Update the Renovate config so mermaid releases land **fast, in one PR, unmixed**:

#Text=- The old `^mermaid` pattern only matched the bare `mermaid` package — the scoped `@mermaid-js/*` packages were falling into the `group:allNonMajor` PR and getting mixed with unrelated updates. Now matched explicitly.
#Text=- Added `"schedule": ["at any time"]` so the mermaid group ignores the repo-wide `schedule:earlyMondays` and opens a PR as soon as a release is detected.
#Text=- `automerge: true` keeps minor/patch bumps flowing automatically.
#Text=- Verified the lockfile diff only changes mermaid specifiers; remaining churn is pnpm recomputing peer-dependency resolution suffixes (no other top-level dep version changed)
